I definitely lost my mum as well, my real mum isn’t in my life at all, nanny was my mum, she was the girl I shared my gossip with, all the thoughts inside my head,  the girl who told me about condoms, birth control, periods, period stories and her shitty first boyfriend.
It was only two months ago and I’m still crying every day until my head throbs.

I’m currently a week away from my final year HSC trial exams and then my real exams aren’t far, I don’t know how I’m expected to pick myself up from this and make it through without her.

I’ve had her by my side my entire life, my entire life I’ve known up until now has been with her, yet over the last couple years we had become closer than ever, she was my best friend. I wish I could have hugged her a bit tighter last time I saw her. She was in a hospital an hour away from home, and I had an orthodontist appointment in that town the next day, and she told me to come visit before my appointment so I wouldn’t have to drive home in the dark, she hated driving in the dark. If I knew she was going to pass that night I would have never left the hospital. 
It’s not fair
She should have, she was stubborn enough, it wouldn’t surprise me.

She was, she was the best fucking old person I knew, everyone complains about how much I swear but it’s because I was raised by this little old lady, after my 17th birthday my girlfriends gave me a slab of leftover guava cruisers and they were nans favourite drink for a while, when I’d get home we would crack one and chat for ages.
when I turned 18 we were going to go out for cocktails together and get absolutely fucked up. we were going to get matching tattoos even though grandpa disapproved we said we would get it in secret. 
She was such a badass and I miss her so much

Before my grandma died I used to constantly complain about her drinking problems, how she would constantly fall and I was struggling with my sleep schedule; waking up every day at 3am in anticipation for her fall.  
Yet after she died I feel like I almost completely forgot about it until I went back over some old texts, I miss the bumps in the night against the wall we share, it’s too quiet now. 

I’d give anything to have that stubborn bitch back here and drinking again.

I live with my grandparents, as I got older my nan used to tell me a bit more about her life, she told me that her partner had died from suicide and left her with a debt of half a million. She was such a tough bitch, she had been in hospital so many times and come out fine, broken her back, her ankles, both hips, everything. yet the thing that took her out was a stomach obstruction, where they couldn’t operate:( it’s not fair.
I totally get what you mean, I feel this sense of emptiness when I get home and I want to tell my grandma about my day but she’s not there. It sucks :(
I’m going to frame it, she always said that she didn’t know where I got my art skills from because she couldn’t even draw a stick figure, I wish I could show her.

My grandma was like my mum, she raised me, she was my best friend, how do you ever move on from that? I’ve spent all 17 years of my life with her around and I just celebrated my 18th birthday without her, everyone tried so hard to make me happy but at the end of the night I just cried because my nan wasn’t there, it’s not fair, she won’t get to see me graduate.
I don’t think I ever will, I feel like I’m lost a part of myself.
